content:
maria (Marketing): Hey team — just wrapped the customer interview with FieldVoice. Recording + raw notes here: https://drive.redwood/fieldvoice-interview. Need a quick approval loop for the quote we want to use in the blog and the launch tweet. Embargo: 2025-11-22 08:00 PT.

devin (CS): Recording uploaded. TL;DR: they call reduced inference cost by ~40% and cut median latency from 320ms to 180ms.

maria (Marketing): Great. Proposed quote for the blog is:

```
"Redwood cut our inference costs nearly in half and made customer-facing features finally feel snappy." — Alex Rivera, VP Eng, FieldVoice
```

Can legal sign off on using title + name? Also want a 1-2 sentence soundbite for the tweet.

julie (Legal): Quick check — do we have a signed release? I don't see one in the folder. If not, we need their explicit opt-in for name + title. Also remove any PII from the transcript.

devin (CS): We have an email chain with permission to be quoted, but it doesn't include title. I can ping Alex to confirm title usage.

sam (Product): For the webinar, we want Alex on a 20-min case study panel on 11/28. Can we confirm timeline? If quote gets cleared today, we can add him to the speaker list.

jon (Growth): Also routing note — inbound leads from the webinar should go to the mid-market SDR queue. @devin can you tag leads as fieldvoice-demo in HubSpot so we can track conversion? :slightly_smiling_face:

devin (CS): Yup I'll add the contact property and set routing. Will also drop a short demo request template for SDRs.

maria (Marketing): Alternate, more social-friendly soundbite for the tweet:

"FieldVoice cut inference costs ~40% and halved latency — our users noticed immediately. 🚀"

julie (Legal): If Alex confirms title, the blog quote is OK after we redact product IDs from the transcript. Also request: please use the exact wording from the release permission; avoid paraphrasing facts that imply guaranteed outcomes.

maria (Marketing): Understood. I'll send Alex a confirmation email with transcript excerpt and the exact quote. Drafting now:

```
Hi Alex — thanks again for the time. Quick confirmation: can we publish the quote below with your name and title? Embargo 11/22 08:00 PT.

"Redwood cut our inference costs nearly in half and made customer-facing features finally feel snappy." — Alex Rivera, VP Eng, FieldVoice

Please reply 'approve' to confirm or suggest edits.
```

devin (CS): Pinged Alex via email and Slack DM. He said he'll reply by EOD.

ops-bot: Transcript generated and uploaded: https://transcripts.redwood/1765432100 (action: auto)

maria (Marketing): If we get approval, can someone from legal drop a final ✅ in this thread so I can proceed with scheduling the blog + webinar slot?

julie (Legal): Will confirm once I have the signed release + title confirmation. if Alex replies 'approve' in Slack, that's fine for our records — ask him to CC legal@fieldvoice.com.

jon (Growth): Heads up — editorial wants a 75-word case snippet for the benchmark narrative. maria i'll DM a template.

maria (Marketing): Thanks all. I'll update here when I have Alex's reply and attach the signed release. Plan: finalize quote + tweet copy today, schedule blog for embargo, add webinar invite.

devin (CS): Alex approved the quote and confirmed title in Slack. He CC'd legal. Forwarding thread.

julie (Legal): Received. Cleaning transcript now and stamping approval: legal-signoff-1765432100. You are clear to use the quote and the tweet copy. Please do not include internal metric IDs.

maria (Marketing): Awesome — proceeding. Final tweet copy:

"FieldVoice lowered inference costs by ~40% and halved latency with Redwood — users feel the difference. Read their story 11/22. https://redwood.ai/stories/fieldvoice" 

sam (Product): Added Alex to webinar panel invite for 11/28. @maria send him the speaker brief.

jon (Growth): SDR playbook updated with routing + tags. I'll monitor lead flow post-webinar.

maria (Marketing): Blog scheduled for embargo 2025-11-22 08:00 PT. Thanks everyone :tada:

devin (CS): Nice work team.

ops-bot: calendar-event-created webinar: fieldvoice-case-study-1765432100
